mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (member_id, treatment_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, member_memo, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{treatmentId}, #{reservationDate}, #{reservationTime}, #{memberMemo}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id, member_id, treatment_id, admin_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, reservation_status, member_memo, admin_memo, pms_sync_status, created_at, updated_at FROM reservation WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY reservation_id
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET treatment_id = #{treatmentId}, reservation_date = #{reservationDate}, reservation_time = #{reservationTime}, member_memo = #{memberMemo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE reservation SET reservation_status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
